text:
rebecca: Quick sync — we had 2 security-conscious DP leads (FinHealth, GovCloud) ask for an on-prem private preview. Can we scope a minimal PD (private deployment) design partner path?

alvin: +1. What are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

rebecca: Must: VPC + KMS integration, audit logs export, per-route SLA. Nice: HSM, air-gapped installer, per-model pinning UI.

marco: For Dedicated we already have per-route SLA, but private needs install docs + attestation checklist. Timeline? :calendar:

rebecca: Targeting 6-week pilot start. Need recruitment copy, success metrics, and eval cadence.

lina: Suggest success metrics: 1) 95th p latency within baseline, 2) no data exfil incidents, 3) test prompts pass privacy eval set.

tom: For recruitment copy — we should call it 'Private Preview: Secure Inference Cohort' and offer 3 months dedicated support + assisted deployment.

rebecca: Draft outreach snippet:
```:
Hi <name>,
We're running a private preview for Redwood Private focused on secure on-prem inference. We'll help with deployment, KMS integration, and benchmark your workload. Commitment: 4-6 weeks, 2-hour weekly checkins.
Interested?
```

alvin: tiny tweak: change '4-6 weeks' to '6 weeks' to align expectations.

marco: Runbook ask: define rollback criteria & fallback plan if model performance regresses during tuning. Put this in the eval cadence doc.

lina: Eval cadence proposal: weekly automated perf run (latency/cost), biweekly qual check with 10 canonical prompts, and a final acceptance run vs baseline.

devops-bot: Deployment job started by @marco at build-2026-03-19T09:14Z — logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/345

tom: Regarding incentives: offer $10k credit + 1 FTE day of SRE/time-of-engineer. That worked well before.

rebecca: Recruitment priority: 1) security/reg compliance, 2) diverse token lengths and concurrency, 3) willingness to run weekly eval harness.

alvin: Question: acceptance gate = pass privacy eval + latency delta < 15% and qualitative satisfaction from partner?

rebecca: Yes. Add 'documentation completeness' as soft gate — must have step-by-step install runbook and perf dashboard access.

marco: I'll sketch a minimal install playbook this week. Lina can you assemble the privacy eval set?

lina: On it. I'll paste the sample prompts later today.

rebecca: Great. Next: who owns outreach? @tom? If so, can you prepare the slack/email template by Friday?

tom: Yep — will share draft Friday EOD. :thumbsup:

rebecca: Cool. Meeting to finalize scope Thursday 10am. @channel please RSVP.
